messages:
Sam: Heads-up — starting onboard for v3.2-lite (int4 hybrid) into canary ring at 5% now. want to flag the VVM-based auto-fallback thresholds we discussed earlier.
Ria: Awesome — which VVM variant are we using? concordance_vvm or fidelity_delta? :eyes:
Sam: concordance_vvm primarily, plus a composite longdoc_fid for docs-heavy slices.
Jin: Quick note: int4 hybrid showed ~0.8% drop on shortanswers in offline sims, but latency improved. sample size small though.
Sam: Yep saw that. plan is 5% canary -> 20% ramp if stable. if concordance_vvm delta <= -0.03 over a 1h rolling window we roll back automatically.
DeployBot: Deploy started: canary v3.2-lite -> clusters: canary-01, canary-02. ID: db-deploy-1714443332 :rocket:
Alex: Do we have slice-level watchlists configured? I want a separate alert for longdoc MRR.
Maria: Added these slices to the watchlist: [shortanswers, longdoc, rerank-heavy]. Also added a synthetic traffic seed for longdoc.
Ria: Can we publish the canary policy snippet here so oncall can eyeball?
Sam: Paste of the policy we pushed to rollout service:
```yaml
policy: 
  canary_pct: 5
  ramp_steps: [5, 20, 50]
  stability_window: 60m
  metrics:
    - name: concordance_vvm
      comparator: delta
      threshold: -0.03
      action: rollback
    - name: longdoc_fid
      comparator: delta
      threshold: -0.02
      action: pause
    - name: latency_p95_ms
      comparator: absolute
      threshold: 120
      action: investigate
```
Jin: Suggest adding a minimum sample floor to avoid noisy rollbacks, e.g. require n>=500 in window.
Sam: Good call — added sample_floor: 500 to metrics in live config.
Alex: Oncall will need a low-noise alert. Can we make the rollback channel only trigger if two consecutive windows cross threshold? reduces flapping.
Maria: We already have hysteresis: 2-window confirmation for rollback, 1-window for pause. config reflected.
Ria: Early telemetry: concordance_vvm at -0.012 in first 15m, longdoc_fid flat, latency p95 down ~8ms.
Sam: Nice. If concordance goes below -0.025 and stays there for 30m we should cap ramp and notify SRE.
DeployBot: Canary metrics heartbeat: 15m snapshot uploaded. Link: https://console.redwood/internal/canary/1714443332
Jin: Running a quick AB compare on the seeded longdoc traffic — sending a diff report in a sec.
Alex: FYI we should add a postmortem tag if rollback happens within 24h for audit.
Ria: Report from Jin: on seeded longdoc traffic, MRR delta = -0.015 (p=0.07), concordance_vvm delta = -0.02, samples=620.
Sam: That's under the rollback threshold but above pause threshold; since hysteresis requires 2-windows, we hold. continue monitoring.
Maria: Alert rules: severity=sev2 if rollback triggers, sev3 for pause. Oncall rota tagged: @oncall-ml
Jin: Small note — quant artifacts seen on a handful of prompts (short tokenization mismatch). logging those to the eval board: /evals/1714443332/artifacts
Ria: Ok. If we hit the rollback, what's the fallback route? v3.1-stable on dedicated, routed automatically by policy, right?
Sam: Correct — routing policy has auto-fallback to v3.1-stable with a warm KV cache bounce. should be seamless.
Alex: One more ask: capture a 1h pre/post snapshot for rng-seed parity checks. helps rule out sampling variance.
Maria: Done — snapshot scheduled and stored under canary-1714443332/snapshots.
Ria: 45m update: concordance_vvm = -0.028 (window avg), longdoc_fid = -0.005, samples=810. Still below rollback threshold but approaching.
Sam: Hold the ramp to 20% for now. Notify product.
DeployBot: Ramp halted at 5% by policy: reason=hysteresis_threshold_near.
Jin: Will run a focused eval on the 120-longdoc seeds to inspect edge-case failures.
Ria: 1h mark: concordance_vvm = -0.033 (window avg), next window pending.
Sam: Because of 2-window confirmation, prepare rollback playbook but don't execute yet. escalate to SRE and ML lead.
Alex: Oncall acknowledged. prepping rollback runbook: rollback steps + traffic-drain + validation smoke tests.
Maria: Notifying product and support channels now.
Jin: Sending artifact list for SRE: /evals/1714443332/artifacts/list.csv
DeployBot: Canary rollback triggered by policy at 1714443410. Rolling back to v3.1-stable. Actions: traffic-repoint, drain, post-checks.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Postmortem checklist: collect canary windows, AB diffs, artifact examples, latency traces. I'll own the writeup if we need one.
Ria: Good job catching it early. lesson: tighten sample_floor for shortanswer-heavy traffic. :thumbsup:
